history.caution: Experimental 0.25 prerelease. Packages are unsigned. Broader Photoshop layer-style compatibility is deferred and unsupported originals remain protected. Manual macOS/Linux desktop interaction and interactive clipboard transport acceptance remain unverified.
notes: Native-depth PSD/PSB opening and saving, reviewed save losses, retained previous-file versions and stronger recovery.
Twelve categorized native effects, compact independent settings, native-precision HSV/HEX pickers, editable patterns, gradient stops, contours and Bevel channels.
Source-bound selection and transform gestures, held-input cancellation guards, actual click-release coordinates and guarded selected-content Cut/Paste.
Production export presets and layer batches, canvas/tablet controls, editable Pen paths, effect baking, transform snapping and per-tool brush settings.
Bounded Photoshop imports preserve strict definitions and exact current standard composites. Broader Photoshop layer-style fidelity is deferred; unsupported originals remain protected.

874 local Rust checks and 18 packaging checks passed; eight optional checks were ignored and two local clipboard checks excluded. Exact-source platform CI, source/archive/checksum verification and actual public downloads were verified. macOS/Linux manual desktop interaction remains unverified.

history.label: PeerBrush 0.2 · Prerelease
history.caution: Experimental 0.2 prerelease. All packages are unsigned; Windows/macOS may show publisher or security warnings. macOS requires Apple silicon. Manual macOS/Linux desktop verification remains pending.
notes: Project tabs, guarded cross-project transfers, retained transforms, clone/heal, crop/resize, text and editable vectors.
Independent selections; DEL deletes layers, Ctrl+D duplicates the current layer selection, Ctrl+G groups and Ctrl+Shift+G merges. Folder guides, full-row menus and the connected Add mask selector.
Common raster and supported static SVG/SVGZ imports, Windows image-file paste, searchable categorized effects and presets, compact effect weights and typed slider values.
Broader native-depth GPU previews, RGB matrix/TRC and classic LUT ICC support, standard PSD full layer/folder locks and protected unsupported originals.
Guarded live AI code editing through the shared engine, with blue feedback, reservations, takeover and task undo that preserves human work.
Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS arm64 packages passed exact-source CI and archive/source/checksum verification. All are unsigned; macOS/Linux manual desktop interaction remains unverified.

2026-10-10 packaging correction: removed duplicated website-only trailer, demo PSD and showcase images. Windows 26.5 MB, Linux 29.0 MB, macOS 25.5 MB; matching source 11.7 MB. Original 0.2.0 executable bytes are unchanged; GPL source, application artwork/fonts, user guides and license notices remain included. Packages remain unsigned.
